email.title: Email
email.description: The email of your Roborock app account. Sign in from Add accessories: the password or the emailed code stays in the vault.

baseURL.title: Region
baseURL.description: The Roborock server of your account. Empty: found from the email.

language.title: Language
language.description: The language of the names the plugin gives the mop washing switch and the brushes and filter. Renaming them keeps their place in HomeKit.

matterDevices.title: Matter devices
matterDevices.description: Robots the Homebridge plugin publishes over Matter. Homeswift publishes them over HomeKit, and its Matter bridge shows them to other ecosystems.

debugMode.title: Debug log
debugMode.description: Logs the plugin's debug lines (requests and transports), never a key or a token.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Publishes the room each robot cleans to an MQTT broker of yours.

topic.title: Topic
topic.description: The topic, with {duid} for the robot's id and {name} for its name.

cleaningPollSeconds.title: Poll while cleaning (seconds)
cleaningPollSeconds.description: How often the robot is asked for its room while it cleans.

L'e-mail de votre compte de l'app Roborock. Connectez-vous depuis Ajouter des accessoires : le mot de passe ou le code reçu par e-mail reste dans le coffre.
